latest.title: Harmonic morphisms of sub-Riemannian Lie groups
latest.abstract: We prove that harmonic morphisms between sub-Riemannian Lie groups are smooth, are symmetries of the sub-Riemannian Laplacian and are conformal submersions that satisfy a particular PDE. Moreover, we give some partial results for harmonic morphisms beyond Lie groups. We show the existence of harmonic coordinates for harmonically homogeneous spaces, and that smooth harmonic morphisms are symmetries of the Laplacian in all sub-Riemannian manifolds. Finally, we compute the first variation of the horizontal energy along a harmonic morphism of sub-Riemannian Lie groups: it is given by a linear form on the Lie algebra of the target, the modular mismatch, which vanishes for Riemannian and Carnot targets, but surprisingly not in general. Therefore, unlike in the Riemannian case, harmonic morphisms of sub-Riemannian Lie groups need not be harmonic maps.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 证明亚黎曼 Lie 群间调和态射的光滑性、共形浸没性质及次拉普拉斯对称性，并计算水平能量一阶变分。
latest.breakthrough: 揭示亚黎曼调和态射未必是调和映射，指出与黎曼和 Carnot 目标情形不同的模差障碍。
latest.limitations: 完整结论主要在 Lie 群间建立；一般亚黎曼流形仅有部分推广。 本条基于已检查来源的阅读分析，关键结论请回查原文。
latest.aiEvidence: ChatGPT 用于编辑、文献辅助与数学讨论；Claude 对定理 9.3 的构思起重要作用，作者独立核验。
latest.priorityReason: 正则性与反例机制兼具，能澄清亚黎曼几何中常被沿用的黎曼直觉。
